target_customer: Non-technical operations teams at companies adopting AI agents, with 30+ companies reported using it
problem: Agents lack shared context across systems and teams cannot easily split work between AI and humans, which blocks enterprise agent adoption.
product_category: Agent and human workflow orchestration with organizational knowledge graph

founders.name: Tim Cherkasov
prior_employers: fintech data science roles including hedge funds
founders.background_notes: YC page says he launched an institutional product for State Street at Copper.

founders.name: Artur Romanov
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built a grocery data-enrichment ML pipeline and led backend work at logistics and finance companies.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to many enterprise tools, building a knowledge graph and a visual human and AI workflow builder is standard but broad product engineering for three people.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated organizational context could lock in customers, but workflow tools like Zapier and n8n and ticketing tools adding agents can copy the pattern.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TechCrunch in February 2026 flagged Jira and similar tools launching their own agents as a threat; no copy that killed Trace was found.

market_need_then: Companies in 2025 piloted agents but struggled to give them context; Zapier and Workato both added human approval steps in 2025, showing demand. Trace reports more than 30 companies using it.

branding.domain_note: Uses trace.so, a .so domain, not the exact .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: unknown, the website was not read

branding.community_and_virality: A third-party profile says it was the most upvoted startup in the YC S25 cohort and launched on Product Hunt; single aggregator, unverified.

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated companies share the name Trace, which hurts search; no press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Trace is an active London company from Summer 2025 that reached 30 plus users and raised a $3M seed in February 2026 per TechCrunch. A Product Hunt post by the founders describes a long road through earlier failed ideas before this one. Main risk is incumbents adding agents to their own workflow products.
notes: Company website fetch was blocked by a rate-limited safety check.
